evidence: Modifies PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages() in src/net_processing.cpp, the central P2P message dispatch loop.
rationale: This is a move-only refactoring that splits SendMessages() into 17 helper methods without altering behavior or retiring a known hazard. While reviewers agree it makes referring to subroutines easier, it addresses internal code structure rather than protocol correctness, DoS protection, or relay performance.
